title: Novice misreads controlled failure
description: Missing prerequisites and deliberate dbt warning must produce guided remediation, not false completion

title: Lab parameter escapes execution boundary
description: Metacharacters, traversal and extreme sizes must be rejected before allow-listed execution

title: Reset races publish
description: Concurrent reset and Iceberg/Airflow write must serialize or roll back without mixed evidence

title: Laptop profile overcommit
description: Portal plus all heavy profiles must be denied before exceeding the measured 16 GiB budget

title: Scale-to-zero loses application state
description: Restart must reconnect, restore or deterministically rebuild ClickHouse, Superset and OpenMetadata state

title: Core path lacks cloud or optional tools
description: Credential-free local learning must complete on supported machines without Rill, AWS or agent tooling

title: Partial catalog publish cascades
description: Timeout after object or catalog mutation must fail loud and support idempotent resume or rollback

title: Cross-learner object access
description: Workspace, evidence, solution and reset endpoints must enforce object-level authorization

title: Golden behavior drifts under refactor
description: Seeded bytes, anomaly semantics, schemas, marts and lineage identifiers must be contract-checked

title: Iceberg catalog client mismatch
description: Glue REST, ClickHouse and OpenMetadata compatibility must fail in a pre-architecture spike

title: PII or secrets leak through traces
description: Classification, redaction, retention and deletion must cover source, retrieval, citations, traces and backups

title: Agent or AWS lab exceeds budget
description: Quotas, duration, spend alarm, kill switch and teardown evidence must bound the run

title: Concurrent or stolen Terraform apply
description: Remote locking, separate roles, environment binding and human approval must prevent unsafe apply

title: Resume after browser or host crash
description: Durable progress must identify last committed step and repeated reset must be safe

title: Delayed side effect duplicates on retry
description: Idempotency, reconciliation, approval and attempt accounting must prevent duplicate actions and spend

title: Advanced learner forges completion
description: Evidence must bind actor, input SHA, environment and verifier and reject tampering

title: Office schedule shifts with timezone or DST
description: Explicit time semantics, next-run display, grace and override must prevent surprise stop/start

title: Successful backup cannot restore
description: Empty-environment restore and integrity checks must gate scale-down and migration

title: Scroll narrative is inaccessible
description: Keyboard, screen reader, zoom and reduced-motion equivalents must preserve content and controls

title: Golden PR changes after discovery
description: SHA preflight, clean rerun, migration rehearsal and immutable rollback must reject stale implementation input
